title: DNA methylation profiling identifies long-range epigenetic silencing of clustered protocadherins as a key determinant of meningioma progression [cell line]
needs_manual_review_reason: Adjacent-scope per docs/scope.md: overall_design confirms 5 human meningioma cell lines (2 from benign, 3 from malignant meningiomas), not primary patient tissue. Part of the GSE304097 SuperSeries alongside the core patient-tissue records gse-304087-bulk-rnaseq, gse-304094-methylation, and gse-304096-methylation. Corresponding_author, institution, and dates were previously recorded as Not reported despite being present in the live GEO record (matches contact/contributor info shared with sibling series GSE304087/GSE304094/GSE304096); filled in accordingly. sample_count corrected from 5 to 10: the live GEO record lists 10 GSM sample entries (GSM9143061-GSM9143070) even though overall_design describes 5 distinct cell lines, implying 2 array entries per cell line; sample_count here reflects the GEO-reported sample count, not the distinct cell line count. RE-VERIFICATION (2026-07-12): live GEO re-fetch shows the series lists a processed supplementary file (GSE304093_Meythylation_meningioma_cell_lines_processed.txt.gz) plus GSE304093_RAW.tar; processed_data_available corrected from 'Not reported' to true and processed_data_format populated accordingly. SubSeries/SuperSeries structure re-confirmed against live GSE304097 (SuperSeries of GSE304087, GSE304093, GSE304094, GSE304096), matching related_accessions; 10 GSMs (GSM9143061-GSM9143070) and platform GPL33022 re-confirmed.
